# Data dictionary

**Generated by `R/05_data_dictionary.R` on 2026-09-22 18:51. Do not hand-edit.**

Every number below was measured from the files in `data/clean/` at the time
this ran. If a figure here disagrees with prose elsewhere in the repo, this
file is right and the prose is stale.

Judgment calls are not documented here. They live in
[`cleaning_decisions.md`](cleaning_decisions.md), which a person signs.

## Provenance

SOURCE: public Kaggle dataset, ~4,400 listed companies' filed statements. NOT Arkamark data. Real figures, wrong companies. Substitute, not synthetic.
